notes: Manifest declared DOC and that is honoured; content is consistent with a handoff/rationale page. AMBIGUITY WORTH FLAGGING TO THE SYNTHESIZER: absent the manifest this would have scored as a borderline SPEC. Sections 2 and 4 carry hard, testable contracts rather than prose - a named-guarantee table with a one-to-one mapping onto tests in tests/contract/test_model_gateway.py (20 offline tests), and a concrete environment-variable surface (IREPORTS_MODEL_ADAPTER, IREPORTS_LITELLM_BASE_URL, IREPORTS_EFFORT_THINKING, IREPORTS_LITELLM_MODEL_<TIER>, IREPORTS_BEDROCK_MODEL_*, IREPORTS_BEDROCK_BASE_URL, IREPORTS_LIVE_SMOKE) with per-tier effort defaults orchestrator=medium, thinking=high, fast=low. Treat those as constraints INHERITED from the ADRs below, not as new authority originating here. PROVENANCE: this page is the evidence behind ADR-015 (two adapters behind one port, both on the official Anthropic SDK), ADR-016 (.env loaded at entry points only, never inside library code - asserted by the orchestrator; not restated in this page's body), ADR-017 (LiteLLM native /v1/messages, base URL used verbatim, optional per-tier model override for shared proxies), ADR-018 (a requested schema is verified, not trusted) and ADR-019 (structured output as a single tool call; no tier requires an Opus-class model). Where this page and docs/DECISIONS.md differ, DECISIONS.md wins - note that section 1 still describes structured outputs via output_config.format, which ADR-019 supersedes with the single-tool-call mechanism, while ADR-018's StructuredOutputError guard survives. KNOWN-OUTSTANDING, carried honestly in section 6 and real forward work: mypy --strict reports 13 pre-existing errors, all in tests/contract/ (nine unused type: ignore comments, four missing annotations in test_decision_support_boundary.py); no package under packages/ is affected, and an earlier revision of this page wrongly recorded the gate as clean. Other explicit gaps: the bedrock adapter has never been run in any partition; the litellm adapter has one live run, commercial partition only, nothing proven about GovCloud; the live endpoint is more permissive than the first-party API (accepted temperature and thinking.budget_tokens with HTTP 200); refused-specialist to InformationGap wiring is Milestone 2; no retry/fallback, no streaming, no prompt caching. Open questions Q-01 and Q-13 are referenced by id only, so no path was captured for OPEN-QUESTIONS.md. FILENAME NOTE: no hashing tool was available in this session, so the collision-avoidance suffix is the flattened source path (docs-handoff-md) rather than a SHA-256 prefix, matching the sibling classification already in this directory; it remains unique per source path.
